_comment: MINIMAL PLACEHOLDER SCOPE. Any target/URL not matched here is rejected before the tool runs. This ships intentionally tight (loopback + the public Acunetix test site only). ADD ONLY networks/hosts you are AUTHORIZED to test — e.g. your lab CIDR (192.168.x.0/24). Do NOT re-add whole RFC1918 ranges unless you truly own them. Point MCP_SCOPE_HOST_FILE at an out-of-tree file for your real engagement scope.
